reason: We already pay premium fees, so if this app really helps, the school should include it. One diagnostic report doesn't tell me it will raise my child's marks or rank. I'll wait to see what the school and other parents say.
objection: There's no proof it improves exam marks, and with one shared phone in the evenings my child would barely get time on it. Why am I paying separately for something the school brought in?
would_change_my_mind: The school recommending it officially, or other parents in the class showing me their children's marks went up after using it this term.
